decisions.statement: A change may have a path the repository ignores.
A path the repository ignores is parted from the paths a landing commits.
A path the repository ignores is written onto the tree rather than committed.
A path the repository ignores that is taken away is renamed aside rather than unlinked.
A folder the repository ignores is taken away as a folder rather than renamed aside.
A path that is not there is renamed aside by nothing.
A change the repository ignores no path of is parted by nothing.
A name renamed aside by a process that died before the unlink is taken away by nothing.
Nothing here writes a body onto the tree.
Nothing here renames a path aside.

definition: the paths in a change the repository ignores rather than commits
